sql: SELECT (WITH allowed AS ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id FROM companies c WHERE true OR c.id = ANY (public.get_user_company_ids(auth.uid())) ), scope AS ( SELECT * FROM allowed WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT * FROM allowed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM allowed WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL) ), last_leads AS ( SELECT company_id, max(created_at) AS last_lead_at FROM campaign_leads WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) GROUP BY company_id ), lead_weeks AS ( SELECT company_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS leads_7d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at < now() - interval '7 days' AND created_at >= now() - interval '14 days') AS leads_prev_7d, count(*) AS leads_30d FROM campaign_leads WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY company_id ), recent_convos AS ( SELECT id, company_id, created_at FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.company_id, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.company_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND c.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' ) x WHERE rn <= 100 ), responses AS ( SELECT rc.company_id, extract(epoch FROM (fm.ts - rc.created_at)) / 60 AS minutes FROM recent_convos rc CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(m.timestamp) AS ts FROM wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = rc.id AND m.from_me AND m.metadata->>'source' IN ('platform', 'phone') ) fm WHERE fm.ts IS NOT NULL AND fm.ts >= rc.created_at AND fm.ts < rc.created_at + interval '30 days' ), response_stats AS ( SELECT company_id, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes) AS median_minutes, count(*) AS samples FROM responses GROUP BY company_id ), waiting AS ( SELECT w.company_id, count(*) AS waiting, min(w.last_message_at) AS oldest_waiting_at FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = w.lead_id WHERE w.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND NOT coalesce(w.is_closed, false) AND w.last_message_from_me = false AND w.last_message_at < now() - interval '2 hours' AND w.last_message_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND l.status::text IN ('novo', 'em_contato', 'orcamento_enviado', 'aguardando_resposta', 'cliente_retorno') GROUP BY w.company_id ), instances AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (company_id) company_id, status FROM wapi_instances WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) ORDER BY company_id, connected_at DESC NULLS LAST ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'whatsapp_status', CASE WHEN i.status IN ('open', 'connected') THEN 'connected' WHEN i.company_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'disconnected' ELSE 'unknown' END, 'last_lead_at', ll.last_lead_at, 'leads_7d', coalesce(lw.leads_7d, 0), 'leads_prev_7d', coalesce(lw.leads_prev_7d, 0), 'leads_30d', coalesce(lw.leads_30d, 0), 'response_median_minutes', rs.median_minutes, 'response_samples', coalesce(rs.samples, 0), 'waiting', coalesce(wt.waiting, 0), 'oldest_waiting_at', wt.oldest_waiting_at ) ORDER BY s.name), '[]'::jsonb) FROM scope s LEFT JOIN last_leads ll ON ll.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN lead_weeks lw ON lw.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN response_stats rs ON rs.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN waiting wt ON wt.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.company_id = s.id) AS out
